title: D3.js
summary: Diagrams in the fashion-film language: hairlines, thin tall numerals, tiny tracked-out small print, a lot of empty space and one poppy accent (a dot, a hairline or one bar). Charts, sequences and comparisons that fade up and draw on quickly, settle for a long time and keep a barely visible push-in. On a bone card by default; "field": "noir" (or sky, meadow, stone, dusk) gives white lines on a dark wash, and "clear": true draws white lines straight over footage. Four bolder ones for fast edits (pause-bars, cut-strip, edit-pulse, bar-race) fill their bars and lines with the accent, take the bold grounds (poppy, cobalt, sun) and can read their data from the project.
usage: {"piece": "d3/bar-chart", "props": {"title": "…", "unit": "Illustrative · …", "items": […], "field": "bone"}}. Every piece takes title, unit, field, clear, accent (poppy, cobalt, sun, white), speed (2 = entrances twice as fast) and times (seconds at which each item appears, e.g. when it is spoken; see each description for what the entries mean). Numbers take decimals, prefix, suffix. Sample data is illustrative. Files: library/themes/fashion/d3/pieces/ (_local.js holds shared timing helpers, not a piece).

items.name: Bar chart
items.description: Hairline-thin bars rising from one rule, figures above in thin tall numerals; the tallest (or highlight) is the single accent bar. Props: items [{label, value}], highlight, max, barWidth. times: one per bar.

items.name: Line chart
items.description: One hairline drawn across the card with the accent dot riding its tip; the latest value and a note sit beside the end point. Props: values, labels, note, min, max. times: [line, value].

items.name: Thin ring
items.description: A faint circle with one hairline arc drawn round to the share, the accent dot on its tip and the figure in the middle. Props: value, total, label, note. times: [arc, small print].

items.name: Dot grid
items.description: A share counted out in dots: a quiet grid of pin-points, the counted ones filling in one by one, the last in the accent, with the figure beside it. Props: value, total, cols, label. times: [count, small print].

items.name: Range and marker
items.description: One to four ticked scales, each with a firmer segment for the usual range and the accent dot gliding to the value. Props: rows [{label, from, to, value}], min, max, ticks, ends. times: one per row.

items.name: Steps
items.description: Three or four numbered stages standing on one hairline, names and notes as small print beneath; the accent dot marks the stage that arrived last (or active). Props: steps [{label, note, number}], active. times: one per step.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: Dates in thin tall numerals down a vertical hairline with the event and a line of small print beside each; the accent dot follows the latest entry (or highlight). Props: items [{date, label, note}]. times: one per entry.

items.name: Calendar strip
items.description: A week between two hairlines: weekdays as small print over tall dates, marked days dotted and listed below like credits. Props: days [{day, date}], events [{at, label, note}] (up to 3). times: [strip, event 1, event 2, …].

items.name: Versus
items.description: Two columns either side of a vertical hairline: a name, one tall figure, then credits-style rows comparing them; the accent dot sits over the winner. Props: a, b {name, value, note}, rows [{label, a, b}] (up to 4), winner. times: [left, right, row 1, …].

items.name: Ranking list
items.description: A credits-style list: number, name, figure and a hairline under each row; one row carries the accent dot. Props: items [{label, value}], highlight. times: one per row.

items.name: Slope
items.description: Before and after on two vertical hairlines with a thin line joining each pair; the biggest change (or highlight) takes the accent. Props: items [{label, from, to}], labels, min, max. times: one per line.

items.name: Measure
items.description: A measured panel drawn like a pattern piece: a hairline rectangle in true proportion with a dimension line under it and an accent one beside it. Props: width, height, labels {width, height}, suffix. times: [outline, width, height].

items.name: Pauses cut
items.description: Every pause cut from a recording as bars in the order they happened; the longest take the accent and their figures and the total counts up. use: "project" draws the real pauses from the edit decision list. Props: pauses, top, note, field (bone, noir, poppy, cobalt, sun …).

items.name: Raw to edit
items.description: Two strips to one scale joined by ribbons: the recording with its pauses in the accent, and the edit underneath, as much shorter as it really is; both lengths in thin tall numerals. use: "project" draws the real edit decision list. Props: before, segments, a, b, cutAt, closeFor, field.

items.name: Edit pulse
items.description: Changes per second across the clip as one filled line drawn left to right, the busiest second marked, the average in numerals and a row of counts beneath. use: "project" counts everything from the storyboard itself. Props: values, counts, show, drawFor, field.

items.name: Bar race
items.description: A bar-chart race: thick coloured bars spring out and re-sort as the figures change (bars slide past each other, rank numerals roll); at flagAt the leader pulls ahead, takes the accent and a flag lands on its bar. Props: items [{label, values: [per step], thumb}], times, flag, flagAt, axis, colors, field; labels (inside | above), showValues (with prefix, suffix, decimals) prints the figures counting at the bar tips; the default shows none and says it is illustrative.
